slots.jd.health-center.about:
Summary
Cedar Ridge Community Health provides accessible, compassionate primary care to every member of our community, regardless of ability to pay. We are seeking an on-site Medical Assistant in Tacoma, WA to support our providers and patients through daily clinical and front-office work. A current Phlebotomy Certificate is required for this position.
slots.jd.health-center.duties:
Duties
- Take and record vital signs for patients before each provider visit.
- Stock and restock exam rooms with supplies so rooms are ready throughout the day.
- Relay physician instructions to patients clearly and confirm they understand next steps.
- Room patients and prepare them for examinations and procedures.
- Update patient records accurately and keep the care team informed of changes.
slots.jd.health-center.needs:
Licensure and qualifications
- Phlebotomy Certificate required.
- 4 or more years of experience as a medical assistant in a clinical setting.
- Experience with specimen handling and patient intake.
- Working knowledge of appointment scheduling and insurance verification.
- Familiarity with medical coding and prior authorizations.

slots.r1.b2: Schedules follow-up visits and coordinates specimen handling so lab results are ready for each return appointment.
slots.r1.b3: Relays physician instructions to patients and manages instrument sterilization between visits, reducing exam room turnover time by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Completes insurance forms and performs insurance verification before each visit to prevent billing delays at check-in.
slots.r1.i1: Supports physicians at Sutter Street Shop by relaying care instructions to patients and confirming they understand their next steps.
slots.r1.i2: Rooms patients at Sutter Street Shop, preparing them for exams and recording the details physicians need before each visit.
slots.r2.b1: Drew blood samples and logged each draw in Epic Systems, reducing specimen labeling errors by 25 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Roomed patients and performed EKG testing ahead of physician exams to keep visits on schedule.
slots.r2.b3: Stocked exam rooms and aligned restocking with appointment scheduling, cutting supply shortages during clinic hours by 35 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Took vital signs during patient intake and entered readings into the chart for physician review.

slots.summary.1: Medical assisting professional with about 4 years of experience carrying a full patient load without close supervision. Skilled in Epic Systems, appointment scheduling, patient intake, vital signs and specimen handling.
